summary: Explicit source-gap triggers fence registered IVM views in the same uncovered source commit

replay.detail: No historical replay, automatic initialization or recovery.

schema.detail: Explicit library installation creates three local triggers on an existing validated gap singleton. No default schema migration, shared layout or version change.

rules.detail: No admission, authority, canonical or checkpoint rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds an opt-in Views gap-trigger API. Batch hook failures preserve their anyhow context chain.

manual.detail: Library adopters explicitly install the bounded trigger for their finite shared registry. No st3 capture adapter or read migration is installed.

recovery.detail: Same-transaction gaps fence availability without changing output or certified cut. Clearing a gap never restores Ready; source-domain and lifecycle recovery remain adapter-owned.
